lines.text: Many learners say: I enjoyed very much the movie.
Better: I enjoyed the movie very much.
Put very much at the end.
The film very much! I enjoyed the film very much.

data.wrong: I enjoyed very much the movie.
data.right: I enjoyed the movie very much.
data.why: Put very much at the end.

native.tip: very much는 문장 끝에! “I enjoyed the movie very much”예요.

en.tip: Put very much at the end. Say “I enjoyed the movie very much”.
en.caption: Do you say “I enjoyed very much the movie”? 😅 The object comes right after the verb, and very much goes last. “I enjoyed the movie very much” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
